sql.app.getLatestAppByAppTypeIdAndType: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, a.archived, ap.minimum_required_build_number, a.app_type_id, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.show FROM flow.app_attachment a INNER JOIN flow.app_type ap ON ap.id = a.app_type_id WHERE a.app_type_id = :appTypeId AND a.attachment_type_id = :attachmentTypeId AND a.archived IS NOT TRUE and a.show is true order by a.date_created desc LIMIT 1
sql.app.getMinVersionForType: select minimum_required_build_number from flow.app_type where id = :appTypeId
sql.app.saveMinVersionForType: update flow.app_type set minimum_required_build_number = :minBuildNumber where id = :appTypeId
sql.app.deleteById: UPDATE flow.app_attachment SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById WHERE id = :id
sql.app.getAttachmentsByType: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, a.show, a.app_type_id, ap.app_type, ap.minimum_required_build_number, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.archived FROM flow.app_attachment a INNER JOIN flow.app_type ap ON ap.id = a.app_type_id INNER JOIN flow.attachment_type at ON at.id = a.attachment_type_id WHERE at.id = :attachmentTypeId AND a.archived IS NOT TRUE order by a.date_created desc
sql.app.showOrHideAttachment: UPDATE flow.app_attachment SET show = :show, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId WHERE id = :id
sql.app.insertAttachmentRecord: INSERT INTO flow.app_attachment (filename, content_type, s3_key, size, date_created, company_id, attachment_type_id, app_type_id, created_by_id, display_name, version_number, build_number) VALUES (:filename, :contentType, :key, :size, now(), :companyId, :attachmentTypeId, :appTypeId, :createdById, :displayName, :versionNumber, :buildNumber)
sql.app.findById: SELECT aa.*, ap.app_type FROM flow.app_attachment aa inner join flow.app_type ap on ap.id = aa.app_type_id WHERE aa.id = :id
sql.app.deleteBySourceAndType: UPDATE flow.app_attachment a SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById WHERE a.app_type_id = :appTypeId AND a.attachment_type_id = :attachmentTypeId
